method: Cross-reference every claim against source JSON data files, controlled experiments, and fuseeval reviewer critiques

items.title: MemTether system
items.evidence: 534 tests passed, CI green, 23 adapters, production 30d
items.action: KEEP: This is the system itself, verified by tests

items.title: Production deployment 30d/15 agents/31K ops/0 loss
items.evidence: Production data exists, but 0 loss is self-reported, not automated monitoring

items.title: Memory Court 5/5 tamper detection
items.evidence: Tested on 200-entry DB with 5 scenarios, all detected
items.caveat: Tamper detection 5/5 is from SYNTHETIC 200-entry test, NOT production 2378-entry DB. The paper conflates these.

items.title: Conflict gate B1 100% precision 0.037ms
items.evidence: Synthetic benchmark only; production contradiction rate is 0.044%
items.action: KEEP with caveat: synthetic only, production rate extremely low

items.title: Latency all <20ms
items.evidence: Measured on production DB: search 5.9ms, write 1.2ms, supersede 3.2ms, verify 19.9ms
items.caveat: Latency uses SQL LIKE, NOT the actual memsearch pipeline (vector+keyword+FTS5+literal). Reported latency does not reflect real search performance.

items.title: LangChain integration + PyPI
items.evidence: Published and pushed to GitHub

items.title: GovernedMemory Bench 8005 tasks
items.evidence: 4 dimensions, all objective ground truth, temporal split
items.caveat: GovernedMemory Bench is a DATASET, not a RESULT. No external system has been run on it.

items.title: LongMemEval 62.4% strict / 68.8% judge > mem0
items.evidence: eaf_500q_full_v2_result.json: strict 206/330, judge 340/494; mem0 60.2%/65.2%
items.caveat: LongMemEval 62.4%/68.8% uses DIFFERENT DENOMINATORS (330 vs 494). This is exactly the denominator mismatch problem the paper criticizes.

items.title: Supersession prediction F1 values
items.evidence: MULTIPLE CONTRADICTORY VALUES: 0.947 (DistilBERT, old) vs 0.977 (leaked, FAKE) vs 0.930 (includes leak) vs 0.692 (honest) vs 0.857 (optimized) vs 0.502 (ablation config)
items.action: REMOVE: 0.947, 0.977, 0.930 (all tainted by leakage). KEEP ONLY: 0.692 (honest random CV), 0.857 (threshold-optimized), 0.502 (ablation)

items.title: Entity grounding = proxy not causal
items.evidence: Production: 0-0.2% supersession. Controlled: NOT significant (5pp, power 35%). PSM: significant. Cross-system: NOT significant. Contradiction!
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'Entity grounding correlates with stability but controlled experiment does not confirm causation'

items.title: 4-system behavioral spectrum
items.evidence: mem0 ceiling at 20, Hindsight at 100, SimpleMem expands 1.19x. BUT: only 200 records, 1 config per system, no repeated trials
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'observed under our test configuration; other configs may differ'
items.additional_issue: 4-system comparison used DIFFERENT EMBEDDING MODELS (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 vs Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B). Confounded comparison.

items.title: Temporal leakage task-dependent
items.evidence: MemTender ClockScore 0.103 vs LoCoMo 0.035 vs Synthetic 0.421. Universal hypothesis DISPROVEN by our own LoCoMo data
items.caveat: LoCoMo event ground truth uses lexical overlap >= 0.4, which is crude and may misclassify. The content-determined label may be wrong.

items.title: Supersession taxonomy 7 categories kappa=0.702
items.evidence: Double LLM-labeled (not human), 48 disagreements, third LLM adjudication failed (all 'other')
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'LLM double-labeled, not human-verified'

items.title: Write governance: dead 9.5%, injection 0.48%
items.evidence: Production data, 30-day observation, 153/1651 = 9.3% (age-corrected)
items.caveat: Dead rate 'never retrieved != useless'. A memory might be relevant but never queried in 30 days.

items.title: evalguard 15 violations / 33 frameworks
items.evidence: Binomial p=0.10, not statistically significant for 'widespread'. Framework count inconsistency (33 vs 47 vs 50 across versions)
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'exploratory finding, not evidence of widespread problem'

items.title: PSM entity effect p<1e-26
items.evidence: 542 pairs, 1 vs 94. BUT: matching on source+type+confidence+reads may not capture all confounders. And cross-system test shows effect disappears
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'observational matching within one system'
items.additional_issue: PSM does not control for content similarity, temporal proximity, or scope. p<1e-26 may be overstated.

items.title: RD analysis entity cutoff
items.evidence: entity=0: 26.3%, entity=1: 0%. BUT: n=67 for entity=1, and this is the same system-specific mechanism
items.action: KEEP as supporting evidence for PSM, not standalone

items.title: Controlled experiment: entity NOT causal
items.evidence: 200 matched pairs, delta=5pp, power=35%, not significant
items.action: KEEP: This is an honest negative result

items.title: Controlled synthetic: 90% vs 0%
items.evidence: By construction: entity-keyed deterministic rule vs exact-duplicate-only rule
items.action: KEEP but label clearly: 'mechanically reachable, not evidence about real deployments'

items.title: ClockScore definition
items.evidence: Formally defined with 3 properties, computed on 3 datasets

items.title: ClockScore correctly orders 3 task types
items.evidence: MemTether 0.103 > LoCoMo 0.035, Synthetic 0.421. BUT: only 3 datasets, 1 research group, synthetic is circular validation
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'validated on 3 in-house datasets'

items.title: 4-system behavioral spectrum
items.evidence: CONTRADICTION: We claim 'fundamental architectural dichotomy' but only tested 200 records, 1 config per system, no ClockScore on competitor prediction tasks, no repeated trials
items.action: DOWNGRADE: From 'fundamental discovery' to 'preliminary observation under limited conditions'

items.title: Friday 41.3% / 11AM 46.7% supersession
items.evidence: Production data: Friday 172/416, 11AM 105/225

items.title: Never-read 52.4% supersession
items.evidence: Production data: never-read facts have 52.4% supersession vs 1.4% for read-once

items.title: Direction reversal strict/judge gap
items.evidence: LongMemEval/LME-V2: judge > strict. LoCoMo: strict > judge. McNemar analysis performed
items.caveat: 25.3pp metric bias tested on n=75 (small sample). Semantic matching is our own implementation, not a standard metric.

items.title: Composition effect 27x
items.evidence: Non-paired gap 38.5pp vs paired 1.4pp = 27x. BUT: this is Simpson's Paradox, a well-known statistical phenomenon
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'application of known statistical phenomenon to new domain'

items.title: mem0 ceiling at 20 memories
items.evidence: 200 records → 20 memories, no growth in any phase. BUT: 1 config, 1 LLM, no repeated trials
items.action: KEEP with caveat: 'under our test configuration with Kimi-k2.6 extraction'

items.title: Hindsight aggressive consolidation 30→1
items.evidence: Earlier test showed 30→1. Later test with 200 records showed 200→100. INCONSISTENCY!
items.action: CONTRADICTION: 30→1 vs 200→100. Different bank_ids, possibly different consolidation stages. RESOLUTION: consolidation is progressive, not immediate

items.title: SimpleMem expansion 1.19x
items.evidence: 200 records → 237 memories. Linear growth across all 4 phases. Unique finding.
items.caveat: SimpleMem 'expansion' is actually different GRANULARITY (splitting complex records), not true memory growth.

items.title: Joint MI 0.581 bits (96.7%)
items.evidence: Discretized joint MI over all features. Replaces earlier claim of '45.9% unexplained'

items.title: 25.3pp strict metric bias
items.evidence: Oracle ceiling: 15/31 strict-matched failures were semantically correct
items.action: KEEP: Important finding about evaluation methodology

items.evidence: 3 benchmarks, 2 systems, McNemar paired analysis
